page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.12xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it is equipped with AMD EPYC 9T95 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The configuration provisions 48 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per virtual core.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, necessitating network-attached storage volumes for operating system disks and persistent data storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps and contains no dedicated GPU hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

By maintaining a dense 1:2 memory-to-core balance, the server allows organizations to run compute-intensive processes without paying for underutilized RAM capacity. However, the absence of onboard NVMe storage shifts IOPS performance entirely to remote storage infrastructure. This instance profile is engineered for compute-heavy workloads such as continuous integration build agents, batch data processing, distributed compilation, and high-concurrency web services.
